mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.status, ur.amount FROM matching m JOIN user_request ur ON m.request_id = ur.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (matching_id, user_id, amount, payment_status, payment_method, payment_key) VALUES (#{matchingId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, 'READY', 'KAKAOPAY', NULL)
